sections.heading: Meters that stay out of the way
sections.body: One small gauge per Devkitty window shows aggregate CPU activity, memory (anonymous, wired and compressed) and home-volume disk usage. It has no card or title: drag it anywhere in the window.
bullets: Hover for the five highest CPU consumers among readable processes
Hidden only when a window shows a single standalone browser pane
